h1s.text: Red Light Therapy Quiz in Salem, WI

acceptedAnswer.text: Full body red light therapy is $25.99. Face and head red light therapy is $14.99 and can also be added during a massage. Full body red light during an existing session is a $22.99 enhancement, in addition to the main service price.

mainEntity.name: How much is red light therapy at Matrix?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Face and head red light is a $14.99 add-on during a massage. Full body red light can be included during a session for an additional $22.99. Select the matching enhancement when booking or text Matrix to arrange it.

mainEntity.name: Can I add red light therapy to my massage?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It helps you explore your goals, compare services and understand relevant research. It does not diagnose a condition, calculate a light dose, prescribe medication or guarantee results. Answers that suggest a medical concern route to clinician review.

mainEntity.name: Does this quiz diagnose a condition or prescribe a treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with one visit, then review comfort, tolerance and whether the experience fits your goals. Research protocols differ by device and condition; this quiz does not prescribe a treatment frequency. There is no required series.

mainEntity.name: How often should I book red light therapy?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Prices and the booking menu are available without completing the quiz. The personalized report uses the existing name, email, phone, consent and verification process.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to complete the quiz to book?

acceptedAnswer.text: Matrix is at 24804 75th St, Salem, WI 53168, serving Salem Lakes, Paddock Lake and nearby Kenosha County communities. Text 262-939-9325 with questions about a visit.
